title: Aye maut theherja
body:
Aye maut theherja
hichkiyan lete thay ali akbar umme laila ye bain karti thi
poshaak udhaloon ke mai armaan nikaloon
ay maut teher jaa ay maut teher jaa
mai apne jawan laal ko dulha to bana loon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
is laal ko mai kaise karoon tere hawale
ye chand to deta hai zamane ko ujale
is chand ki poshaak sitaron se sajaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
athara baras phoolon ki tarha jise paala
jaata hai mujhe chod ke wo gesuon wala
ab tu hi bata kaise mai is dil ko sambhaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhe thay bahut khaab magar khaak hue sab
is bete ke sehre ki dua karti thi zainab
dulah na sahi mai ise dulah sa banaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
har shaam jise lagti hai ab shame gharibaan
jo kehti thi akbar ki dulhan laaungi amma
us fatima sughra ko madine se bulaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime se zara door khade rote hai sarwar
ek haat kalaje pe hai ek haat kamar par
mai khud ko sambhaloon ke shahe deen ko sambhaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kiski nazar kha gayi is noore nazar ko
veeran kiye jaate hai akbar mere ghar ko
jee karta hai is chaand ko dunya se chupaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke labon par hai buka haaye muqaddar
kya sehra chadhaun mai teri lash pe akbar aur khud ko teri laash pe sadqe hi utaroon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
mehendi na lagi haaton may hai khoon badan ka
pooshak-e-shahani ko mila daag kafan ka
is laash pe athaarveen mannat ko badhaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
taqdeer kisi maa ko ye manzar na dikhaaye
maiyat pe jawaan laal ke wo ashq bahaaye
jee bhar ke ise dekhloon aur ashq bahaun
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
faryaad zara sunle sakina ki zubaani
marjaungi bichda jo mera yousuf-e-saani
bhaiya mere naraaz hai mai unko manaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
<<DIVIDER>>
maa roti rahi mazhar-o-irfan tadapkar aur aakhri hichki may safar kargaye akbar
maa kehti rahi mai ise dulah to banaloon
<<MINI>>
...ay maut
